subject.title: fix(ci): bound qa-profile-evidence git fetch operations with timeout

question: Should the QA evidence workflow adopt the established 120-second Git-fetch deadline and 10-second termination grace for both selected-ref fetches?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes when a slow network operation becomes a workflow failure; only the workflow owner can accept that availability-versus-latency policy for CI.

options.title: Accept the bounded deadline
options.body: Merge the focused change because it matches the previously accepted bounded-fetch pattern and includes a regression guard for both affected fetches.

options.title: Choose a different CI budget
options.body: Ask for a revised timeout or grace period if QA evidence fetches have a known legitimate duration beyond the proposed limit.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded deadline
recommendation.body: Merge the focused change because it matches the previously accepted bounded-fetch pattern and includes a regression guard for both affected fetches.
